system.description:
Puppet is an @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03traitrolls0000]{opposed roll} of the character’s @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor05powers.JournalEntryPage.05arcanebackgr00]{arcane skill} versus the target’s @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Spirit}. With @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03traitrolls0000]{success}, the victim automatically obeys commands that don’t directly harm himself or those he cares about.

With a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03traitrolls0000#trait-rolls]{raise}, the target is completely controlled, but gets an automatic @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Spirit} roll as a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03actions0000000]{free action} to avoid directly harming himself or those he cares about. If the puppet’s resistance @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03traitrolls0000]{succeeds}, he doesn’t carry out that particular command but doesn’t otherwise resist his master. With a @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03traitrolls0000#trait-rolls]{raise}, he breaks the controller’s hold and the power ends.

Commands are general, such as “attack that person” or “open that door.” The controller doesn’t get to dictate how many @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03actions0000000]{actions} the victim uses in a turn, whether or not he uses his @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-edges.Sweep]{Sweep} Edge, etc.
system.trapping: Glowing eyes, trance-like state, a swinging pocket watch, voodoo dolls.

powerModifiers.name: Additional Recipients
powerModifiers.description: Spend 2 additional Power Points per extra recipient. Resolve Spirit resistance separately for each target.
